**3B.4 Research Note**

Best-supported read: mixed but somewhat positive on police-force regulation and accountability for politically protected actors, with major gaps on prison oversight, complaint handling, and independent investigations beyond the federal police/political sphere.

- [Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública body camera guidelines](http://dspace.mj.gov.br/handle/1/12967) — Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública — 2024-05-28  
  - Claim-level summary: Lula’s justice ministry issued national guidelines for body cameras in public security agencies, emphasizing standardized recording, transparency, evidence preservation, and tighter control over police conduct. This is direct system-building for civilian oversight.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.4; also 3B.1

- [Relatório do MJSP apresenta diagnóstico sobre o uso de câmeras corporais policiais](https://www.gov.br/mj/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/relatorio-do-mjsp-apresenta-diagnostico-sobre-o-uso-de-cameras-corporais-policiais) — Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública — 2024-07-31  
  - Claim-level summary: the ministry summarized studies linking body cameras to lower police lethality and more reporting, reinforcing that Lula’s government treated recording and review as tools to deter abuse.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.4; also 3B.1

- [Decreto que atualiza regras sobre o uso diferenciado da força pelas polícias é publicado](https://www.gov.br/mj/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/decreto-que-atualiza-regras-sobre-o-uso-diferenciado-da-forca-pelas-policias-e-publicado) — Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública — 2024-12-24  
  - Claim-level summary: Lula signed a decree updating police use-of-force rules and less-lethal instruments, framed around professionalization, efficiency, and respect for human rights. This is the clearest 2024 federal reform aimed at reducing arbitrary force.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.4; also 3B.1

- [Brazil marks anniversary of Jan. 8 attack on democracy](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/brazil-to-mark-anniversary-of-january-8-attack-on-democracy-3269163) — Reuters via Investing.com — 2024-01-08  
  - Claim-level summary: Lula said those who financed, planned, and executed the coup attempt should be punished. That is evidence for accountability rather than shielding politically connected violators.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.4; also 3B.1, 2B.9

- [PF desarticula organização que planejou golpe de Estado com planos de assassinar Lula e Alckmin](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/11/19/pf-desarticula-organizacao-que-planejou-golpe-de-estado-com-planos-de-assassinar-lula-e-alckmin.htm) — Reuters via UOL — 2024-11-19  
  - Claim-level summary: federal police arrested four military personnel and a federal police officer over an alleged plot to kill Lula and stage a coup. This supports the existence of investigation and enforcement even when suspects were inside protected state institutions.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.4; also 3B.1, 2B.9

- [Brazil: Comply with Rulings on Police Violence](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/15/brazil-comply-rulings-police-violence) — Human Rights Watch — 2024-03-15  
  - Claim-level summary: HRW said Brazil still had not fully complied with Inter-American Court rulings requiring independent investigations of police killings, and described lethal raids, unlawful force, intimidation, and evidence tampering. This is strong counterevidence that abuse remained inadequately controlled.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.4; also 3B.1

- [World Report 2025: Brazil](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2025/country-chapters/brazil) — Human Rights Watch — 2025-01 (covering 2024 events)  
  - Claim-level summary: HRW reported continued police killings in 2024, very limited charging in major cases, and prison conditions marked by overcrowding, unhealthy conditions, and ill-treatment/torture in multiple states. This is the strongest evidence that oversight systems were still not sufficient in practice.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.4; also 3B.1

Search gap: I did not find reliable 2024 evidence of a Lula-led overhaul of prison complaint systems, civilian oversight bodies beyond police body-cam/use-of-force reforms, or a broader independent-investigation architecture for abuse by intelligence services, prison staff, militias, or informal loyalists. The positive evidence is real but narrow; the abuse problem clearly persisted.
